about_the_game:
Story Background

Your parents left a single line—"off to travel"—before handing you this old inn, which they called "full of potential." You’d never run an inn before, but you refused to back down: Can’t balance the books? Learn. Hard to deal with merchants? Adapt. Leaky roof? Fix it! You tend to this little corner of the world, earning every coin honestly and mending every flaw thoroughly. In your free time, you mediate neighborhood disputes; between work, you sneak out to enjoy flowers; during festivals, you climb mountains to pray; sometimes, you steal a glance at the handsome bodyguards with passing tea merchants… Life is simple but lively, and the inn, though old, is warm.

Core Gameplay

The inn management system includes staff management and upgrading, dish development and customization, a regular customer growth mechanism with feedback, a backyard flower-planting system, and other features for inn operation. Unlike traditional simulation games focused on numerical stacking, it emphasizes realism and immersion.

Unique Highlights

By accumulating wealth, you can unlock other map locations and gameplay modes. In Yueming Town, you can be the innkeeper, a teacher educating the young, a matchmaker pairing townsfolk, an underground merchant operating in the gray area, or a strategic chamber of commerce leader. Beyond rich side content, the game has over 200 NPCs—more than 40 core characters have independent side stories, plus a million words of plot. The townsfolk aren’t just background; they’re companions whose fates are tied to yours. Their stories change with your choices, weaving together your unique Moonlit Scroll.

May you, in the world of Yueming Town, not be a slick, all-purpose innkeeper—but a free-spirited ordinary soul. Let your account books hold your livelihood, and your inn’s eaves shelter the warmth of life.
